methodologyNotes: Covers standalone outdoor patio heaters sold at a published US price: freestanding, tabletop, and wall/ceiling-mounted units running on propane, natural gas, or wood pellets, plus electric infrared models. Excludes indoor-only space heaters, decorative fire pits with no published heat rating, chimineas, and fire tables. Price is typical US street price or MSRP in USD. fuelType is an enum: propane, natural-gas, electric, or pellet. heatOutputBtu is peak rated heat output in BTU per hour; for electric units this is the manufacturer's BTU-equivalent (watts x 3.412). powerWatts is electric power draw in watts at the maximum setting, null for combustion (gas/pellet) units. mountType is an enum: freestanding, tabletop, wall-ceiling, or hanging. heatTechnology is an enum: reflector-flame (gas burner plus reflector dome), open-flame (visible fire), quartz-infrared, or carbon-infrared. coverageSqFt is the manufacturer-stated heated coverage area in square feet, null if not published. heightInches is assembled height in inches. weightLbs is unit weight without fuel in pounds. runtimeHrs is hours of operation at max output on one full standard fuel supply (a 20 lb propane tank or a full pellet hopper), null for electric or hardwired units. variableHeatControl is a boolean: true if heat output is adjustable (multi-setting or continuously variable) rather than fixed single-output. ignitionType is an enum: piezo, electronic, push-button, or none (electric plug-in). tipOverProtection is a boolean: true if the unit has an automatic tip-over/tilt shutoff valve or switch.
